name: Multi-view Mini-batch Rasterization
aliases: Multi-view mini-batch training for 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A training strategy that renders multiple viewpoints in a single mini-batch to reduce gradient variance and improve convergence, modifying the standard 3DGS rasterizer pipeline.
summary: Multi-view mini-batch rasterization renders multiple viewpoints simultaneously in 3D Gaussian Splatting to reduce gradient variance and memory consumption.
